propositions: commit_and_push_tickets_branch stages with 'git add -A', which unintentionally includes .bridge_state/last-pass.json (a per-pass timestamp) that should be excluded, causing idempotent passes to advance HEAD when they should not
_commit_binding_store_snapshot composes git_adapter.add + git_adapter.commit directly outside the locked transaction instead of using the shared write seam, violating the atomic commit contract
A new pathspec-capable commit_tickets_branch helper must be extracted from commit_and_push_tickets_branch to allow selective 5-file staging without sweeping in dirty non-allowlisted files
The per-file idempotency behavior (only staging and committing files that are actually dirty among the 5 allowed .bridge_state files) must be preserved when switching to the shared locked seam
The fail-open contract (seam failure → False + stderr + dedup'd bridge_alerts) must remain unchanged for _commit_binding_store_snapshot's exception handling
The raw-git-ok marker on reconcile_helpers.py must be removable once _commit_binding_store_snapshot routes through the locked pathspec-scoped seam with strict=True
